changelog:
2.3.2

  • Security review fixes.
  • Updates: only zips from DIM's releases folder are accepted; if the published fingerprint can't be confirmed at install time the update is refused instead of skipped; stricter manifest checks.
  • Texting: blocks Caribbean +1 countries, toll-free and premium numbers (SMS-fraud protection); numbers Twilio Lookup places outside the US/Canada are refused.
  • Sending is one-at-a-time per site so parallel requests can't exceed the hourly/daily limits.
  • Phone numbers and email addresses are scrubbed from stored error messages and alert emails.
  • Delivery webhook also checks the Twilio account ID and ignores unknown statuses.
  • Review links must be Google addresses and map embeds Google Maps embeds.
  • Removal: only pages containing nothing but this plugin's shortcode are trashed; staff logins' content is reassigned to an administrator instead of deleted.
  • README no longer shipped in the plugin folder (it revealed the version publicly); minor PHP 8.x/9 hardening and escaping.
